描述_EN: the illustrations on the label were drawn by london-based illustrator steve small. powder was one of three official mascots for the 2002 winter olympic games in salt lake city, utah, usa. the design process was started in september 1997, and a selection of animals went through focus groups with these three being the most popular. in native american legend the snowshoe hare raced to the top of a mountain to shoot the sun and saved the earth from overheating. the three characters appeared on a wide range of merchandise, with the plush version here licensed to mattel, and manufactured in china. characteristics of the three animals were based on the olympic slogan ‘faster, higher, stonger’. these salt lake city mascots follow in the tradition of the first official mascot, waldi the bavarian dachshund from munich 1972, in being animals representative of the host region. the final characters were designed by a design partnership of landor associates and publicis.
描述_ZN: 标签上的插图是由伦敦的插画师Steve Small绘制的。 粉饼是2002年美国犹他州盐湖城冬奥会的三个官方吉祥物之一。 设计过程开始于1997年9月，通过焦点小组的选择，这三个动物是最受欢迎的。 在美国本土的传说中，雪鞋兔飞奔到山顶射杀太阳，拯救了地球的过热。 这三个人物出现在广泛的商品上，这里的毛绒版本授权给Mattel，并在中国生产。 这三种动物的特征是基于奥运会的口号 "更快、更高、更强"。 这些盐湖城的吉祥物遵循了第一个官方吉祥物的传统，即1972年慕尼黑的巴伐利亚腊肠犬Waldi，它是代表东道主地区的动物。 最终的角色是由Landor associates和Publicis的设计合作伙伴设计的。
